outputs.explanation: Panel A top shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with mean ± s.d. error bars from three independent experiments, but no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the three replicates) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B top shows a bar chart of cell death (%) presumably averaged across replicates, but no individual data points are shown on the bars, only the bar height with error bars.

Panel C shows grouped bar charts of cell death (%) at 24h/48h/72h with mean ± s.d. of three experiments, but the individual data points from each of the three experiments are not overlaid on the bars.
Panel D top shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars, but no individual data points are displayed alongside the bars.
